name: Social
description: Federated social for Möbius people — private messages between instances, a community board, and people search.
author: hamzamerzic

store.description:
Social gives every Möbius a direct way to reach people on other instances. Find someone by handle, send private one-to-one messages, create group conversations, or post to a shared community board.

Messages travel directly between each person's Möbius and each side keeps its own copy. The People directory is opt-in, and the community host can be changed without moving private conversations through a third party.
